text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- International Council for Dialogue among Religions, based in London, awards King Hassan gold medal for his constant work for tolerance and peace.
- Weather forecasts say heavy rains and colder temperatures expected nationwide starting Thursday.
- Collision between a coach and three vehicles on highway linking Casablanca to Rabat kills one, injures five seriously and causes big traffic-jam.
- Authorities to set up "show shops" with fixed sample prices to combat increases ahead of the fasting month of Ramadan.
- Two missing and four rescued after fishing vessel sinks off the coastal city of Larache.
